title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Customer Service Advisor Hebburn, Tyne & Wear £26,000 - £30,000 per annum Full Time Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm 40 hours per week A well-established and growing technology services business is seeking a Customer Service Advisor to join its customer-focused team in Hebburn. Working as the first point of contact for clients, you'll play a key role in ensuring customer enquiries and support requests are managed efficiently while maintaining outstanding levels of client satisfaction. The Role As a Client Success Advisor, you will be the first point of contact for customers seeking assistance and support. Working closely with operational and technical teams, you will coordinate service requests, manage client communications, and ensure a smooth customer journey from initial contact through to resolution. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys developing strong customer relationships, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and takes pride in delivering an exceptional client experience. Key Responsibilities - Act as the first point of contact for customer enquiries, incidents and service requests. - Coordinate and dispatch support tickets in a timely and effective manner. - Deliver a high standard of customer service across all client interactions. - Maintain regular communication with clients, providing updates and managing expectations. - Escalate and manage complaints professionally and efficiently. - Maintain accurate customer records and update CRM systems. - Work closely with internal departments to ensure seamless service delivery. - Monitor service performance and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. - Produce reports and analyse service data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement. - Support the management and achievement of KPIs and service level targets. - Make recommendations to enhance customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. - Utilise business systems and internal technology platforms effectively. - Build strong, trusted relationships with clients and colleagues. About You - Previous experience in a customer service, client services, customer success, helpdesk or service coordination role. - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. - Strong relationship-building abilities. - The ability to prioritise workloads and work effectively under pressure. - Excellent attention to detail and administrative skills. - A proactive approach to problem solving. - Confidence working collaboratively across multiple teams. - A genuine passion for delivering an outstanding customer experience. Desirable Experience - Experience within an IT, technology or service-based business. - Familiarity with CRM and ticket management systems. - Experience working within a KPI or SLA-driven environment. What's on Offer? - Salary of £26,000 - £30,000, depending on experience. - Modern office environment based in Hebburn. - Supportive and collaborative team culture. - Opportunity to join a growing organisation with clear values and a customer-first approach. - Ongoing training and development opportunities. If you're an enthusiastic customer service professional looking to build a career within a growing and dynamic organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Service Representative
description: Where: EE Tyneisde (Silver Fox Way, Newcastle upon Tyne NE27 0 QJ) Full time: Permanent Salary: £26,116 rising to £26.738 after 8 months of being here, plus incentives and bonuses Start date: October 2026 onwards If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE. Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash. Our team's in Newcastle and North Tyneside are full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here. What does being a sales advisor involve? You'll join a lively sales team in our contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell. You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product. Forget what you've heard about sales Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths - Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work. - It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems. - People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console? Why you'll be better off at EE GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months. UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn. BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year. GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT. FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family. GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.
